description: Free. Day-old index of the Agent Weather AI model directory: model id, name, vendor and categories only (models first seen at least 24 h ago; flagged in `snapshot`). Live prices, context length, vendor status, 24h/7d changes, job cost and events are in the paid get_model_report and get_model_category tools. Not a ranking. Supports filtering by vendor, category or text query and pagination (limit/offset). Use the ids with the paid get_model_report tool.
